name: Accessibility
description: Checks basic semantic structure: a <main> landmark, a <nav> landmark, labelled form inputs, and a minimum count of semantic elements. Semantic landmarks help AI parsers and agents locate the main content and navigation, and are a foundation for accessibility.
inputs: rendered DOM body: semantic elements, ARIA roles/attributes, form inputs and labels, skip links

scoring.summary: Start at 4. Deduct 1.75 if no <main> or [role="main"]; 0.75 if no <nav> or [role="navigation"]; 0.75 if fewer than 50% of form fields (input except hidden/submit/button/reset/image, textarea, select) are labelled (only when fields exist); 0.75 if total semantic element count < 5 AND no main. Score = max(0, round to 1 decimal); the engine floors it. ARIA counts and skip link are informational only.

rules.condition: semantic element count = number of elements matching each of: main, nav, article, section, aside, header, footer, figure, figcaption (summed)

fields = 'input:not([type="hidden" i]), textarea, select' minus inputs of type submit, button, reset or image; a field is labelled if its id equals the for attribute of some <label> (compared as strings), or it has a non-empty aria-label or aria-labelledby, or it is inside a <label>. If fields exist and round(labelled/fields*100) < 50
score = max(0, round(score*10)/10); the engine floors it

scoring.status_mapping: Engine rule on the floored score: 4 pass; 2-3 warning; 0-1 fail. Reachable: 4 (no issues); 3.25 -> 3 (missing nav or poor labels); 2.5 -> 2; 2.25 -> 2 (missing main only); 1.5 -> 1; 0.75 -> 0; 0.

detect.source_procedure: Runs per page on the built HTML in the served root: count semantic tags and role attributes, check form fields for labels, then apply the deductions. Components that render landmarks at runtime (Vite SPA shells) are not seen.

parity.note: The extension counts elements in the live DOM after JavaScript, including third-party widgets (cookie banners, chat widgets with unlabeled inputs) that are not in the repo. Component frameworks may render <main>/<nav> from library components whose names do not reveal the tag. Conditionally rendered elements may be present or absent at runtime.

fix_summary: Wrap the primary content in <main> and site navigation in <nav> in the base layout (Astro layout, Hugo baseof.html, Eleventy base layout, Next.js root layout.tsx, Vite App component); add <label for> or aria-label to form inputs. Adding main alone removes the largest deduction.

divergences.extension: Inputs of type submit, button, reset and image are counted as fields that need a <label>.
divergences.plugin: They are excluded; buttons are named by their value or default label.
divergences.reason: A normal search or signup form (one labelled field plus a submit button) could drop below 50% labelled.

divergences.extension: label[for] is found by interpolating the id into a selector, which throws for ids containing quotes.
divergences.plugin: label for values are compared as plain strings.

divergences.extension: Counts elements in the live DOM after JavaScript, including third-party widgets.
divergences.plugin: Counts elements in the built HTML.
divergences.reason: Source-vs-live: the plugin reads the repo.

divergences.extension: Status comes from the unfloored score (e.g. 4.5 is pass) while the reported score is floored.
divergences.plugin: Status is derived from the reported integer score by the shared 80% / 50% rule.
